list.title: Courses
list.description: Your shop copy of the PADI and SSI catalog. Open a course to edit its page and pricing, or hide the ones you don't offer.
list.emptyBody: Every course your shop can teach shows up here, ready to edit, hide, or put on the board.

edit.description: Everything a diver reads before booking — the copy, the photos, and your pricing. The certification and minimum age come from the agency.
edit.depthMarkersHint: Depth markers: type '{depth18}' anywhere in this page and divers read “18 meters” or “60 feet”, whichever unit your shop is set to. The choices are '{depth12}', '{depth18}', '{depth21}', '{depth30}' and '{depth40}'; add an n for the bare number in a range, as in “to '{depth30n}'–'{depth40}'”. Delete a marker whenever you would rather write the depth yourself.
edit.hiddenFromDivers: Hidden from divers and the session picker.
edit.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the fields and try again.
edit.errorImages: You can keep up to eight gallery photos. Remove one before adding more.
edit.errorUpload: That photo didn't upload. Try a JPG, PNG, or WebP under 5 MB.
edit.errorTooManyPhotos: Add up to {max} new gallery photos per save. Save this batch, then add more.
edit.errorDepthPlaceholder: One of your depth markers is broken, so nothing saved. Write it exactly as '{depth18}' — the choices are '{depth12}', '{depth18}', '{depth21}', '{depth30}' and '{depth40}'. If you would rather write the depth in your own words, delete the marker instead.
edit.subheadDescription: One line under the title, e.g. “How to become a PADI Open Water Diver”.
edit.overviewDescription: A few paragraphs in the diver's words, not the agency's.
edit.pricingDescription: Two lines on one order: your instruction fee and the agency's e-learning fee. The diver pays the total in a single payment.
edit.photosDescription: Upload your own photos. New files are added to the gallery; tick a photo to remove it.
edit.galleryPhotosHint: (up to eight in total, {max} new per save)
edit.glanceDescription: The chips across the top of the page — how the course runs. Who may take it is the next box.
edit.nitroxCompatibleLabel: We can run this course on nitrox
edit.nitroxCompatibleHint: Off for courses taught on air. When it is off, sessions of this course never offer divers the enriched-air box — a diver still needs verified nitrox certification before any fill.
edit.enrollDescription: The one block that answers “can I do this?”. The certification and minimum age come from the agency: {levelAge} — not editable. Your note sits under them, labelled as the shop talking.
edit.includedPlaceholder:
6 open water dives
Full rental gear
Light lunch
edit.dayByDayDescription: One card per day: a title, real start/end times when the day runs on a fixed clock (or a free-text note when it doesn't, like "week 1–2"), and what happens.
edit.faqDescription: One block per question, separated by a blank line. First line is the question, the rest is the answer.
edit.faqPlaceholder:
Is equipment included?
Yes — mask, fins, wetsuit, BCD, regulator, and tanks.

Do I need to be a strong swimmer?
You need to be comfortable in the water.

templateUpdates.title: Updates from the source template
templateUpdates.updated: Template updates applied. Your edited fields were kept.
templateUpdates.replaced: Template updates applied and the listed template fields were replaced.
templateUpdates.unavailable: That template update is no longer available. Reload the course and review it again.
templateUpdates.description: This course follows template version {current}. Version {latest} is available. Review the changed fields before choosing how to apply it.
templateUpdates.legacyDescription: This course matches a source template, but its original baseline predates update tracking. The safe action keeps all editable page copy; replace is the explicit overwrite path.
templateUpdates.keepEditsDescription: Keep my edits updates only fields that still match the last template version. Prices, visibility, public URL, and photos always stay with the shop.
templateUpdates.legacyKeepEditsDescription: Because this older course has no original baseline, the safe action keeps all editable page copy. Prices, visibility, public URL, and photos always stay with the shop.
templateUpdates.keepEditsHint: Recommended: your changed course copy stays as-is.
templateUpdates.replaceCopyHint: Overwrites the listed template fields, including your edits to those fields.
templateUpdates.replaceConfirm: Replace the listed template fields with the source version? Your prices, visibility, public URL, and photos will stay unchanged.

dayByDay.timeNoteDescription: For a day with no fixed clock time, e.g. "week 1–2" or "about 3 hours".
dayByDay.timeNoteTitle: Ignored when a start time is set for this day.
dayByDay.itemsPlaceholder:
Classroom: knowledge review 1–2
Pool: confined water skills
Gear wash and debrief
dayByDay.itemsOverMax: Up to {max} items a day — take a line out before saving.
